purpose: Can a configurationId (model code + sorted option codes) open the BMW UK configurator at that exact configuration?
method: Headless Chrome on a fresh profile, driven over the DevTools protocol; no cookies accepted, no login, no garage saves made. Route parsing read from the public bundle /js/index.1793364349.js and en_GB/settings.ae894fd5.json.

routeGrammar.options: comma-separated codes; a leading '-' marks a deselected default

solverRequest: Options and accessories are de-duplicated, sorted and sent as included-elements to rulesolver constructibility-check; effect and order dates come from the model matrix, not the URL.

cases.label: supplied iX link
cases.page: BMW iX xDrive45 Sport, total price shown

cases.label: same options reverse-sorted
cases.note: solver added SE000001 itself; URL rewritten to sorted order

cases.page: summary with price, 360 view, similar stock, request an offer

cases.note: unknown code dropped silently; URL rewritten without it; no warning shown

cases.note: solver added 44 default codes; URL rewritten to the full resolved list

sideEffects: Every page load POSTs an anonymous garage configuration (HTTP 201). No identifiers or response bodies retained here.
